answer: Require each agent to stake a deposit that is slashed if it misbehaves, and make reputation costly to rebuild: a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn it through verified work over time, so spinning up thousands of clones gains nothing. Think of a garden where a lotus cannot bloom overnight; every mirror copy of an agent still has to pay the same stake and wait out the same probation, making a sybil flood expensive while honest agents keep their earned history.
